style: From the reference picture, draw only the one object named below, alone and whole, so it can be turned into a 3D model. Keep its exact shape, colours and glossy iridescent style. Nothing else: no ghost, no head, no body, no hands, no shadow, no text. Three-quarter view from slightly above, centred, filling most of the frame, on a plain pure white background.

ideas.label: Object
ideas.prompt: the deep navy blue beret: a soft flat round felt cap with a rolled band round its rim and the small stalk on top. Seen whole, slightly from above, with its open underside just visible.

ideas.label: Object
ideas.prompt: the smartphone: a modern phone with rounded edges in pale iridescent metal, seen from the back at three-quarter so the square camera bump with three lenses shows, and a little of the side buttons.
